description: This file contains implementation of Unicode string conversion utilities, including offset adjustments for UTF-8 and UTF-16 encodings, as well as functions for converting between these encodings with offset adjustments.

classes.name: OffsetAdjuster::Adjustment
classes.description: Represents an adjustment to string offsets, including original offset, original length, and output length.

methods.name: OffsetAdjuster::AdjustOffsets
methods.description: Adjusts a list of offsets based on a set of string adjustments up to a limit.

methods.name: OffsetAdjuster::AdjustOffset
methods.description: Adjusts a single offset based on string adjustments and a limit.

methods.name: OffsetAdjuster::UnadjustOffsets
methods.description: Reverts offset adjustments based on a set of string adjustments.

methods.name: OffsetAdjuster::MergeSequentialAdjustments
methods.description: Merges two sets of string adjustments into one, maintaining correct offsets.

methods.name: ConvertUnicode
methods.description: Template function converting Unicode characters from source to destination string type, recording adjustments if requested.

methods.name: UTF8ToUTF16WithAdjustments
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 string to UTF-16 with offset adjustments.

methods.name: UTF8ToUTF16AndAdjustOffsets
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 string to UTF-16 and adjusts provided offsets accordingly.

methods.name: UTF16ToUTF8AndAdjustOffsets
methods.description: Converts UTF-16 string to UTF-8 and adjusts provided offsets accordingly.
